name: Codex CLI
description: OpenAI's coding agent CLI. Runs against an openai-style provider through the hotbed proxy - the provider must serve the Responses API (/v1/responses; current Codex dropped chat completions). CODEX_HOME (config + sessions) lives in the workspace.

files.{{state}}/config.toml:
# written by hotbedd sync
model = "{{model}}"
model_provider = "hotbed"

[model_providers.hotbed]
name = "hotbed proxy ({{provider}})"
base_url = "{{base}}"
env_key = "HOTBED_PROXY_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
